name: Validate sales CSVs and generate review ZIPs with n8n forms

parameters.content:
## Upload and validate sales CSV
Authenticated users upload one UTF-8 CSV. Required headers: order_id,order_date,amount,currency. Preserve extra fields; hold invalid rows and conflicting duplicate groups. Max 1,000 rows per upload.

## Compare history and save exact review
Read one release registry. Exclude identical previously released orders and hold historical conflicts. Save an immutable batch snapshot and review hash. Batch IDs must be unique; serialize intake.

## Review the saved batch
Use batch_id and exact review_hash. Download, approve accepted rows or reject. Approval needs RELEASE ACCEPTED ROWS. Commit ledger and receipt atomically with a conditional update; same-decision replays do not release twice.

## Download the result ZIP
Contains report.json, issues.csv, audit.json and draft-sales.csv or released-sales.csv. Rejection returns an empty draft CSV. JSON preserves canonical values; CSV escapes formula prefixes. Demo never saves or releases records.

nodes.name: Sales CSV overview and exact setup

parameters.content:
## Validate sales CSVs and generate review ZIPs with n8n forms

Review recurring sales exports before a manual import. Upload one UTF-8 CSV, validate orders, compare them with previously released batches, and save an exact review. An authenticated reviewer can download, approve the accepted subset or reject it. Each result is returned as an audit ZIP.

### How it works
Checks required columns, calendar dates, currency precision and duplicate groups. An n8n Data Table stores immutable batch snapshots and one authoritative release registry. Approval binds to the review hash and commits the release plus decision in one conditional update. Identical historical orders and conflicting IDs are excluded. No shop or accounting import is executed.

### Setup
Run the separate setup utility once. Copy stateTableId and actual reviewer emails into both Configure nodes. Keep n8n User Auth and Include User in Output enabled on both forms. Run the credential-free demo, then upload examples/sample.csv with a unique batch ID. Copy batch_id and review_hash from report.json into the decision form. Approve requires typing RELEASE ACCEPTED ROWS.

### Requirements and limits
Tested on n8n 2.28.6; Data Tables and n8n-user Forms required. Built-in nodes; no service credentials for this workflow. Required headers: order_id,order_date,amount,currency. One order per row, max 1,000 rows per upload. Run one intake at a time. Registry limits: 5,000 released orders, 1,000 decisions, 4,000,000 serialized characters. Decisions expire after 24 hours by default. Re-upload with a new batch ID if release history changes. Customize limits only with tests.

## Exact release, not external import
Approval releases accepted rows only. Existing history changes invalidate pending approvals. Concurrent decisions use a conditional registry update; retry a failed request. Never edit stored registry JSON. Archive deliberately at capacity. CSV formula prefixes are escaped; report.json retains original canonical values.
